opening.argument: The speaker requires viewers to make a small investment to purchase a miner and presents BitClub Network bitcoin mining as a safe way to generate passive income. That combination makes this a solicitation for paid mining returns: viewers are asked to invest on the strength of an assurance of safety and income. The pitch ties participation to improving quality of life and earning from home, then directs viewers to a link or Facebook page for information. These are direct promotional claims supporting a scam finding, rather than reporting, criticizing, or testing a third-party claim.
